title: General Sherman Tree Trail
map_label: A 3D walk down the Sherman Tree Trail to the General Sherman Tree in Sequoia National Park.

stops.file: Sequoiadendron giganteum & Abies concolor, Sequoia National Park (20806362602).jpg
stops.title: Sherman Tree Trailhead
stops.alt: Giant sequoias and white firs near the Sherman Tree trailhead.
stops.text: The route starts at the Sherman Tree trailhead on the Generals Highway, about 7,000 feet up. The paved trail descends through the grove.

stops.title: General Sherman Tree
stops.alt: The General Sherman Tree, a giant sequoia, towering above visitors.
stops.text: You have reached the General Sherman Tree, by volume the largest known living tree on Earth.
